author: JeTePardonne
body: Evening, I recently was temp banned for excessive caps, based upon infractions from about one month ago. I was warned for caps while my friend Izikw was kicked. After I was given the warn he said it is the wrong infraction and should be a temp ban. I was just wondering if this is how the system works now? If this is how it has always been? Referring back to infractions that were given a month ago and applying it to the current situation? I understand the whole 8 month thing with overall infractions, but it applies to the warn->kick-> temp-ban too? If this is the case, I hate to rad myself out, but earlier in the year I had both a few warns and a kick for caps that were within eight months, and then received another warn afterwards, but not a temp ban? If it has changed from then, all I ask is to have some type of forum post or reference page for the community to have access to view. Explaining how the new infraction systems work, instead of throwing them out into the pool with no floaties ;c. We were told by a mod that there is nowhere on the forums for a player to go to view how infractions are being given out. How is that fair to newer players? I have a lot of infractions, but if you view my page, I have never been temp banned for excessive infractions. I have come very close to it, but  never have I reached that point. When I had about 8 infractions within ten months, I was in a game and a mod personally told me that 10 infractions within 8 months is a temp ban. From then on I behaved myself, trying not to get infractions that would lead to the temp. Not long ago, I learned again in game from a mod, that warns do not count anymore towards the 10 infractions within 8 months. Sure I was really happy, but I was also annoyed that this was something that was told in game, and not put onto the forums for people who were not there to be informed about this to refer to. All I am saying is, if I would have been informed on how infractions are being given out nowadays, I would of been more careful with my caps when talking in chat. Thanks

title: Temp ban

replies.author: Junr
replies.body: Well, it's a cycle, so you are going to see warn, kick, tempban(s), which will lead to a permban eventually. It's always been like that, here's an example, you know when we put Combat Log (1)? That starts the cycle and we add to it. Just imagine you are building a house and you have the frame (the warn). You start with the frame and slowly add on to it, you add the walls (the kick) and then eventually get to the roof (the tempban), some time goes through and an earthquake comes wiping out your house, you start from ground 0, (the cycle repeats). Your kick was more recent, which is why I tempbanned you, also pretty much everyday you are verbal warned by a Mod to stop with the excessive caps, as you use it everyday. Usually you should understand that you will get the ounishment that is after a warn, kick, tempban, etc. It may not seem fair, but it's a  way that will teach players to not break rules constantly. If you are wondering why your friend got a kick, it's because you already had a kick and he only had a warn for it.

I'm going to deem this appeal denied, but I'll leave the thread open for 24 hours if you wish to respond.

Thanks,
